subject.statement: Builder.ai, founded by Sachin Dev Duggal, was acquired by Microsoft in 2025.

summary: VERDICT: FALSE – Microsoft did not acquire Builder.ai in 2025. The decisive facts are that Builder.ai was founded by Sachin Dev Duggal, its legal name is Engineer.ai Cloud Services India Private Limited, it filed for Chapter 7 bankruptcy in Delaware on June 2 2025, it had a partnership (not an acquisition) with Microsoft as reported by the New York Times on August 31 2025, and no Microsoft press release or SEC filing indicates an acquisition.

findings.statement: Builder.ai was founded by Sachin Dev Duggal.
The full legal name of Builder.ai is Engineer.ai Cloud Services India Private Limited.
Builder.ai filed for Chapter 7 bankruptcy in Delaware, with a filing date of June 2, 2025.
Builder.ai had a partnership with Microsoft, not an acquisition, as reported by The New York Times on August 31, 2025.
No official Microsoft press release or SEC filing indicates an acquisition of Builder.ai in 2025, according to The New York Times coverage of its collapse.
